cards.definition_principle: Trying many strategy or parameter variants on the same data can select an apparently strong result that fits noise rather than persistent structure.
measurable_predicates: every trial and parameter set is counted
dataset and code hashes are frozen
valid_conditions: All attempted variants, including failures, remain in the research registry.
failure_conditions: Only the best variant is retained or trial count is unknown.
contradictions: An attractive in-sample metric can be a selection artifact.
when_not_to_use: Do not promote a strategy from a single optimized backtest.
cards.exact_locator: PDF pp.3-5 > Backtest overfitting in finance and investments
cards.paraphrase: Record every attempted variant and separate discovery from untouched evaluation.

cards.definition_principle: A strategy selected on one dataset must be evaluated on time-separated data not used for selection, with the split and all outcomes immutable.
measurable_predicates: no overlapping labels or future features
valid_conditions: The OOS boundary is frozen before evaluation.
failure_conditions: OOS data is inspected during iteration or relabeled after results.
contradictions: A single hold-out can still be overfit through repeated reuse.
when_not_to_use: Do not call in-sample evidence calibrated.
cards.exact_locator: PDF pp.5-7 > Simple Example of Backtest Overfitting
cards.paraphrase: Freeze time-separated evaluation and never recycle the OOS set as another tuning set.

cards.concept: A reused hold-out is not guaranteed protection
cards.definition_principle: A hold-out split is useful but does not control repeated discovery trials or guarantee freedom from overfitting when repeatedly consulted.
measurable_predicates: final untouched test or walk-forward policy is versioned
valid_conditions: The limitation is disclosed beside OOS results.
failure_conditions: Any profitable OOS result is called validated without trial controls.
contradictions: OOS is necessary but not automatically sufficient.
when_not_to_use: Do not use one repeatedly viewed hold-out as final proof.
cards.exact_locator: PDF pp.3-5 > Backtest overfitting in finance and investments
cards.paraphrase: Pair time separation with trial accounting, walk-forward discipline, and immutable final evaluation.

cards.concept: Simulated results require liquidity, cost, and hindsight caveats
cards.definition_principle: Hypothetical results are not actual trading and may misrepresent liquidity effects or benefit from hindsight; research output must disclose those limits.
measurable_predicates: fees and slippage are included or excluded explicitly
no synthetic record enters production empirical evidence
valid_conditions: Synthetic and historical fixtures remain isolated from production statistics.
failure_conditions: Synthetic counts or placeholder metrics enter empirical probability.
contradictions: A realistic simulation still is not broker fill truth.
when_not_to_use: Do not market, calibrate, or promote from undisclosed hypothetical results.
cards.exact_locator: Regulation 4.41 proposed disclaimer > hypothetical performance limitations
cards.short_excerpt: these results do not represent actual trading
cards.paraphrase: Label simulations, include market frictions, and isolate them from authoritative outcome evidence.
